mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of FEDFUNDS decline instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window during easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the UNRATE series above 5.5% triggers labor market tightening, raising inflation expectations and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 5.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window during such events.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 2.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of transitory measures and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rising demand (GDPC1) creates a dual signal of monetary easing and robust economic activity, amplifying equity valuation growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS down and GDPC1 up (p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the PAYEMS series above 1,500 (thousands of persons) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, driving consumer spending and corporate profits, which correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS exceeds 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window during such events.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO indices above historical averages signals robust industrial production, reflecting underlying economic growth and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive during INDPRO upswings (p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in household spending (HOUST) and decline in the federal funds rate creates a reinforcing cycle of demand and monetary easing, driving equity valuation increases and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when HOUST up and FEDFUNDS down (p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year window during such events.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate amplifies market expectations of prolonged growth, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In non-late-cycle regimes, FEDFUNDS decline fails to predict positive returns (p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window during late-cycle FEDFUNDS declines.
